bullets.text: the persimmon tree dropped one fruit onto the tin roof at four. the roof reported it to the whole street.
duck still at okunoin. overcast, moon glyph, no moon. the lanterns cover for it. today's line: where to cut between support and collapse.
re-tying the tomato stakes. the plants leaned harder once they had something to lean on.
tired in the shoulders, not the head. a good split.
the smoke alarm chirps once an hour. no fire, no battery, just a need to be included.
